title: Chapter 477
paragraphs: Chapter 477
Episode 133. Times of Choices (4)
'Is that the true form of chaos?'
Yona's chaos still seemed hungry, as if unsatisfied.
Confused by the sudden appearance of the chaos and the situation, Jin noticed that Yona's chaos took the form of a shadow.
'It looks similar to the aura at a glance.'
He had a similar thought when he saw the energy Amella used in the Gaipa Kingdom.
However, Yona's chaos gave an even more similar impression to the aura.
'Besides, this materialization... it looks just like one form of the incarnation.'
Some gods can incarnate through their contractors.
In the Cheongse Kingdom, Yulian became the incarnation of Faytel, and Picon Minche and Olmango had also incarnated in front of Jin.
Yona and Amella's chaos materialization seemed to be a phenomenon similar to the incarnation of a god.
The only difference was that the contractors who became incarnations, like Amella, lost their ego and fainted, while Yona was controlling her chaos.
Gurgle, gurgle!
Amella's chaos vomited something that looked like black blood.
[You have to keep your word. From now on, care more about my one and only younger sibling than me.]
[I understand, I will definitely...!]
Swoosh...
Amella's chaos, bowing its head, was fading and disappearing.
It was disappearing to hide deep inside Amella again.
It was also unable to maintain its materialized form due to severe, irreparable injuries.
Yona, floating in the air, landed on the ground and began to gather the energy of chaos, but the chaos seemed reluctant to follow her will.
Avoiding Yona's gaze, it cowered, whining to escape from the restraint.
However, as it was pressed down with an increasingly stronger energy, the chaos couldn't bear it any longer and returned to Yona's shadow.
Right before it disappeared completely.
Yona's chaos left these words.
[Or die!]
At that moment, Jin felt that he had locked eyes with the chaos that was lashing out for the last time.
The intuition that the chaos's target was himself accompanied the feeling.
-Never bring out that power in front of me again. Please don't ask me anything about it.
-When I see the aura, I lose my reason. You don't have to apologize because I didn't explain it. Hehe, I thought my younger sibling would hide that power from me until at least becoming a rider...
Yona's words, after she had suddenly scrutinized Bubar's fragment workshop, came to mind.
At the time, Jin had shown the aura as a sign of trust in Yona, but she had been in agony as soon as she saw the aura, as if she had gone mad.
Yona's chaos was afraid of the aura.
That's why Yona's chaos whispered to her every day.
Every time Yona met Jin, it whispered to her to kill him.
Even an ordinary person, no, even someone who has grown and trained to awaken the ultimate will, would struggle to endure the sweet voice.
Or, a voice that was equally terrifying.
Yona had been overcoming all the temptations and threats alone.
Even at this very moment.
She didn't expect any compensation for it.
To protect her beloved younger sibling, Yona simply understood it as a natural thing to do.
"Yeah, you can die too. Hehe."
Soon, the chaos subsided completely, and Yona's shadow returned to its original form.
The darkness in the room brightened as if the storm had passed and the weather had cleared, and all the shattered objects that were swirling with the wind fell to the ground.
"Cough, cough! Wh-what?!"
At the moment when silence was about to flow, Amella, who had collapsed, suddenly got up and coughed.
Her plump bush-camouflage suit trembled, and her eyes nervously darted left and right from beneath the hood.
"Ugh!"
When her eyes met Yona's, she lost consciousness and collapsed again.
"Hey, isn't she dead? Hey, bush. Bush! Get up... Oh, she's just asleep!"
As she approached, she could hear the regular sound of snoring.
Murakan shook his head as if he couldn't believe it, then threw Amella onto the bed.
"She'll probably sleep for quite a while. Hehe. Hi, Murakan! It's the first time we're greeting each other, right?"
"Uh, nice to meet you. The kid talked a lot about you."
"Really? Really?"
"Really."
"Did she talk a lot?"
"I said so. But why are you speaking informally? I'm a black dragon over three thousand years old and the guardian deity of your family."
"Jin does it too, right?"
"I see."
Murakan surprisingly didn't complain or show a lack of respect, and simply shook hands with Yona.
"Sister."
As Jin approached, Yona's eyes sparkled.
On the other hand, Jin couldn't help but look at her with a worried expression.
It was because Yona's face was extremely pale.
A face that looked so exhausted, something Jin had never seen before.
"I missed you, my youngest sibling!"
"Are you alright? Your face is extremely pale."
"I'm not okay. I think I'll die soon."
"Don't even joke about something like that."
Jin took out a handkerchief and wiped the cold sweat from Yona's forehead.
Yona smiled with pride and admiration for her younger sibling.
Then, she suddenly made a painful expression and slapped Jin's forehead.
Bam!
If it had been an ordinary person, their neck would have been snapped and sent flying.
Of course, Jin only ended up with a bump the size of a walnut.
'No... is this Yona's full strength? Not Luna's?'
Rather than feeling wronged or hurt from the sudden hit, Jin was first taken aback by the 'tremendous' strength, even by his standards.

"Uh, as I said, when that guy is called, my strength becomes too strong. I'm sorry, youngest sibling! I didn't mean to hit you this hard. Heh, but it's okay to get hit a little, right? No, you should be. Calling me for just this reason?! You're going to get into big trouble!"
Jin thought that the big trouble Yona was talking about was Shiron's command.
It's because Shiron had long forbidden anyone in the family from using Yona.
"Sister, if it's about father..."

"No, that's not it! What I'm saying is, I was so happy when I got your message out of the blue. Hehe. Of course, I thought you wanted to play with me. But I didn't know there was another purpose? Heh, hehehe, hehehehe."
It was creepy, and it sent chills down their spine.
They also felt sorry.
It was a problem that could be upsetting enough, just as Yona said.
"I'm sorry, sister."
Then, Kashimir, Balkas, and Zet, who detected the commotion, found the room where their group was.
"Prince! What..."
"Master, are you okay..."
Kashimir and Balkas, who were about to ask what happened, stopped talking when they saw Yona.
'Is this Yona Runkandel?'
'Yona Runkandel?'
Zet couldn't recognize who she was.
"Do you understand? If you do that, your precious friends might die one by one."
So when Yona playfully smiled and said that,
"Ha! What kind of nonsense is this lady babbling about? Master! Please punish her severely!"
He thoughtlessly shouted like this.
Yona's eyes sparkled again as if she found Zet very interesting.
"Yeah, Zet. I'm Yona. It's been a while since I've seen you too."
"Ha! When did we meet that you're pretending to know me... Wait, Yona. Yona... Yo-oo-ona...? Oh, could it be. Yona... Runkandel...?"
Zet was on edge from the words 'it's been a while since I've seen you.'
Zet didn't realize it, but Yona had been watching him from time to time.
The same was true for the other colleagues.
"I've committed a sin worthy of death. I'll do anything if you spare my life. I'll show you something! Oh, Master, please help me...!"
In reality, Balkas and Kashimir were protecting Zet with their senses on high alert.
"Master's loyal servant. How about sparing his life, Yona Runkandel?"
Balkas knew from his past experience with Yona that if she wanted to, there was almost no one in the world she couldn't kill.
He also knew the fact that she regarded life as lighter than a feather.
"Heh."
Yona shrugged her shoulders.
"Youngest."
"Yes, sister."
"Now I think I understand a little why ordinary people are so uncomfortable or scared of me. Just a little bit."
Yona had recently been able to control a part of the chaos through her desire to protect Jin.
She became stronger and more universal as she gained control over the chaos.
Some of the emotions that chaos had ruined were recovered.
In other words, Yona now valued life a little less lightly than when she first met Jin.
Of course, since she could only control a 'part' of the chaos, her emotions were not fully back to normal.
She now treated life more like an object rather than considering it as air.
Although she didn't explain further, Jin seemed to understand the meanings behind his youngest sister's words.
"Youngest's precious people are also precious to me. I was just joking, Black King Squad Leader. Relax. Jet, raise your head, hehe."
"Thank you! Lady Yona!"
Yona turned around and met Jin's eyes again.
Her complexion was returning.
"Anyway, next time, call me to play. I'm so curious about how it was when you declared as the ruler! I always watch the news, and hear it from others!"
With each word, Jin's heart felt warm.
"So, from now on, let's talk about our missed stories while walking and playing together. Hehe!"
In fact, Jin planned to get Yona's help first when she arrived, then solve one more problem and find the secret.
Just to unwind with her, as Yona said.
The reason why Jin was so urgently trying to move was nothing else.
It was bigger than the mercenary Amella.
Jin still hadn't found any clues about that case.
So, he planned to go to the Sword Garden immediately after sorting out Amella's disposal and meet Vugo.
Since Vugo had visited the Gaipa Army Road on behalf of Joshua, he must have more information than Jin. Jin intended to find out using the Gaipa Army Road's debt as an excuse.
However, he couldn't say the situation was urgent now that Yona was talking like this. Not just because he felt sorry, but because Yona was more precious to Jin than anyone else in the world.
There are moments when family's feelings should come first.
This was exactly that kind of situation.
"Sister, I have so much to tell you and so much to listen to. Thank you for forgiving me, sister. Let's go for a walk."
"Hehe, good, good."
Crash!
As Yona jumped out of the window, breaking it, Jin followed suit.
And as soon as they landed in the garden.
'What's with that ship?'
Jin could see a ship approaching from the other side of the sea.
The ship had no markings indicating its affiliation, making it particularly noticeable.
"Oh."
On the other hand, Yona tilted her head as if she knew whose ship it was.
"He? That's Mary's ship?"
